# CLI reference

This page is generated from the parser shipped by Boundver. For workflow rules,
configuration examples, and exit-code semantics, use the
[behavioral reference](reference.md).

## Command index

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`boundver generate`](#generate) | Generate or update the lockfile |
| [`boundver verify`](#verify) | Check lockfile matches current repo state |
| [`boundver review`](#review) | Compare reconciled facet identities across a Git range |
| [`boundver diff`](#diff) | Diff two lockfiles |
| [`boundver slice`](#slice) | Show fingerprint for a specific slice |
| [`boundver validate-config`](#validate-config) | Validate config for strict boundary rules |
| [`boundver check-config`](#check-config) | Alias for validate-config |
| [`boundver init`](#init) | Create a starter boundary.config.json |
| [`boundver add`](#add) | Add a component to the config |
| [`boundver remove`](#remove) | Remove a component from the config |
| [`boundver status`](#status) | Show lockfile summary and warnings |
| [`boundver coverage`](#coverage) | Find tracked files missing from declarations |
| [`boundver record-derivation`](#record-derivation) | Record generated-artifact freshness after a trusted generator runs |
| [`boundver explain`](#explain) | Explain changed files for a component |
| [`boundver why`](#why) | Explain why a component's lockfile is out of date |
| [`boundver discover`](#discover) | Find Git-tracked component manifests |
| [`boundver migrate-lock`](#migrate-lock) | Normalize a current lock or explain why regeneration is required |
| [`boundver completions`](#completions) | Emit shell completion scripts |

<a id="generate"></a>

## `boundver generate`

```text
usage: boundver generate [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT] [--source {head,index,working-tree}]
                         [--allow-partial] [--dry-run] [--components COMPONENTS]
                         [--format {json,text}] [--allow-custom-providers]
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | `boundary.config.json` | Config file path |
| `--out` | `OUT` | `boundary.lock.json` | Output lockfile path |
| `--source` | `{head,index,working-tree}` | `head` | Snapshot to fingerprint (default: head): last commit, staged index, or tracked files on disk |
| `--allow-partial` | — | `false` | Allow intentional null facet inputs in slices (not provider or source errors) |
| `--dry-run` | — | `false` | Compute lockfile and print status without writing output |
| `--components` | `COMPONENTS` | — | Comma-separated component names to regenerate |
| `--format` | `{json,text}` | `text` | Output format |
| `--allow-custom-providers` | — | `false` | Allow loading external provider modules declared in the config 'providers' key (or set BOUNDVER_ALLOW_CUSTOM_PROVIDERS=1) |

```text
Examples:
  boundver generate
  boundver generate --source working-tree
  boundver generate --components auth-service,billing --dry-run
  boundver generate --format json
```

<a id="verify"></a>

## `boundver verify`

```text
usage: boundver verify [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--lock LOCK] [--source {head,index,working-tree}]
                       [--components COMPONENTS] [--changed-from CHANGED_FROM] [--fail-fast]
                       [--facets FACETS] [--transitive] [--update] [--strict-config-source]
                       [--baseline PATH | --write-baseline PATH | --update-baseline PATH]
                       [--format {json,text}] [--allow-custom-providers]
```

Verify the lockfile is up to date with the current repo state.

```text
Exit codes:
  0  Selected facets match
  1  Exact or metadata drift
  2  Usage, configuration, or digest error
  3  Behavioral drift
  4  Boundary drift
  5  Compatibility-family drift
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | `boundary.config.json` | Config path inside the selected source snapshot |
| `--lock` | `LOCK` | `boundary.lock.json` | Lock path inside the selected source snapshot |
| `--source` | `{head,index,working-tree}` | `head` | Snapshot to compare (default: head): last commit, staged index, or tracked files on disk |
| `--components` | `COMPONENTS` | — | Comma-separated component names to verify |
| `--changed-from` | `CHANGED_FROM` | empty | Report components changed since a Git ref while verifying full lock integrity |
| `--fail-fast` | — | `false` | Report only the highest-severity mismatch |
| `--facets` | `FACETS` | empty | Comma-separated CLI-wide gate override (default: component verify_facets, then config defaults, then all available facets) |
| `--transitive` | — | `false` | Report the transitive downstream consumer closure for boundary/compat drift |
| `--update` | — | `false` | After reporting drift, atomically regenerate the lockfile if computation succeeds |
| `--strict-config-source` | — | `false` | Refuse --update when the selected snapshot config differs from the same working-tree path |
| `--baseline` | `PATH` | empty | Allow reviewed violation identities from a baseline while failing on new ones |
| `--write-baseline` | `PATH` | empty | Explicitly capture current baselinable violations in a new JSON file |
| `--update-baseline` | `PATH` | empty | Shrink an existing baseline by removing resolved identities; never adds violations |
| `--format` | `{json,text}` | `text` | Output format |
| `--allow-custom-providers` | — | `false` | Allow loading external provider modules declared in the config 'providers' key |

```text
Examples:
  boundver verify
  boundver verify --components auth-service
  boundver verify --changed-from main
  boundver verify --source working-tree --format json
```

<a id="review"></a>

## `boundver review`

```text
usage: boundver review [-h] [--base BASE] [--target TARGET] [--merge-base] [--config CONFIG]
                       [--lock LOCK] [--facets FACETS] [--transitive] [--format {json,text,plan}]
                       [--summary-file PATH] [--allow-custom-providers]
                       [BASE..TARGET]
```

Compare two immutable Git endpoints and report historical facet, consumer, and slice impact.

A complete review exits 0 whether or not identities changed. Missing history, invalid endpoints, or unreconciled config/lock state exit 2. Reconcile and commit both endpoint locks first; use verify separately as the current-tree integrity gate.

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `BASE..TARGET` | `BASE..TARGET?` | — | Explicit Git endpoint range |
| `--base` | `BASE` | — | Explicit base Git ref |
| `--target` | `TARGET` | — | Explicit target Git ref |
| `--merge-base` | — | `false` | Compare the unique merge base of BASE and TARGET to TARGET |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | `boundary.config.json` | Config path at both endpoints |
| `--lock` | `LOCK` | `boundary.lock.json` | Lock path at both endpoints |
| `--facets` | `FACETS` | empty | Comma-separated policy override; all four identities are always compared |
| `--transitive` | — | `false` | Report the transitive downstream consumer closure |
| `--format` | `{json,text,plan}` | `text` | Output format; plan is the versioned CI routing projection |
| `--summary-file` | `PATH` | empty | Write a bounded Markdown summary of --format plan |
| `--allow-custom-providers` | — | `false` | Allow trusted custom provider modules while recomputing both historical endpoints |

```text
Examples:
  boundver review origin/main..HEAD
  boundver review --base origin/main --target HEAD --merge-base
  boundver review main..feature --transitive --format json
  boundver review main..feature --format plan --summary-file plan.md
```

<a id="why"></a>

## `boundver why`

```text
usage: boundver why [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--lock LOCK] [--base-ref BASE_REF]
                    [--source {head,index,working-tree}] [--format {json,text}] [--transitive]
                    [--allow-custom-providers]
                    component
```

Compare current fingerprints against the lockfile and explain what changed.

Shows which facets (exact/behavior/boundary/compat) drifted, what type of change it is, and which files are responsible.

```text
Exit codes:
  0  Component is up to date
  1  Component has drifted
  2  Usage error (unknown component, missing config, etc.)
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `component` | `COMPONENT` | required | Component name from config |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | `boundary.config.json` | — |
| `--lock` | `LOCK` | `boundary.lock.json` | — |
| `--base-ref` | `BASE_REF` | — | Git ref resolved to an immutable commit for changed-file diagnostics (default: commit that introduced the component's current lock entry for source=head; HEAD otherwise) |
| `--source` | `{head,index,working-tree}` | `head` | Fingerprint source to compare against (default: head) |
| `--format` | `{json,text}` | `text` | Output format |
| `--transitive` | — | `false` | Report the transitive downstream consumer closure |
| `--allow-custom-providers` | — | `false` | Allow loading external provider modules declared in the config 'providers' key |

<a id="migrate-lock"></a>

## `boundver migrate-lock`

```text
usage: boundver migrate-lock [-h] [--lock LOCK] [--dry-run | --explain] [--config CONFIG]
                             [--source {head,index,working-tree}] [--format {json,text}]
```

Normalize a supported current-schema boundary.lock.json in place. Hash-contract v1, v2, and v3 locks cannot be upgraded safely and are rejected with instructions to regenerate from repository content. Use --dry-run to preview normalization as JSON, or report that the lock is already normalized, without writing it.

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--lock` | `LOCK` | `boundary.lock.json` | Path to lockfile (default: boundary.lock.json) |
| `--dry-run` | — | `false` | Print prospective normalized JSON, or report a no-op, without writing the file |
| `--explain` | — | `false` | Analyze and classify every boundary/behavior selector under v0.10 and current semantics without writing |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` | `boundary.config.json` | Config used by --explain |
| `--source` | `{head,index,working-tree}` | `head` | Source analyzed by --explain (default: head) |
| `--format` | `{json,text}` | `text` | Analysis output format used by --explain |

## `boundver completions`

```text
usage: boundver completions [-h] --shell {bash,zsh,fish}
```

Print a shell completion script to stdout.

```text
Installation:
  bash:  boundver completions --shell bash >> ~/.bash_completion
  zsh:   boundver completions --shell zsh > ~/.zfunc/_boundver
         (add ~/.zfunc to $fpath before compinit)
  fish:  boundver completions --shell fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/boundver.fish
```

| Argument | Value | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-h`, `--help` | — | — | show this help message and exit |
| `--shell` | `{bash,zsh,fish}` | required | Target shell |
